title: My robot vacuum mapped a room I do not have 🤖
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 2:10 in the morning my robot vacuum drew a new room on its map.

scenes.narration: At 2:10 in the morning my robot vacuum drew a new room on its map.
My flat has four rooms. The app showed five. The fifth was small, with one door, right next to my bedroom wall.
I checked my bedroom wall. Wallpaper. Plain. Cold. I knocked. Nothing answered, but the vacuum started to move.
It drove through the wall. Not around. Through. The little blue line crossed the plaster and carried on.
The app updated. Obstacle detected. Cleaning around, person. The person was standing still. In the middle of the fifth room.
Then my mobile buzzed, from the app. Cleaning complete. Returning to dock. And the vacuum rolled slowly back out of the wall, covered in something wet.
The map showed the fifth room one last time. Then the label changed. Not the fifth room. Your room. And my own room, on the map, turned grey, as if it was the one being cleaned away.
So tell me. Do you knock again, or leave the flat?
